title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 108 North Main Street in Bucoda, Washington, as the "Mayor Rob Gordon Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 108 North Main Street in Bucoda, Washington, as the Mayor Rob Gordon Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress named the post office at 108 North Main Street in Bucoda, Washington, after former mayor Rob Gordon.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility in Bucoda, Washington, as the Mayor Rob Gordon Post Office. It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or how the building operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
